0022600015.text: The Hornets (3-2, first in the Southeast and sixth in the East) visit the Wizards (2-3, third in the Southeast and eighth in the East) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Charlotte coming off a loss and Washington on a two-game losing streak. Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Tre Johnson (Achilles soreness) and Tristan Vukcevic (pinched nerve in the hip). The Hornets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 110-103 win in Charlotte on October 26, and they also won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season 4-0.
